home_override_note: GAMESS scratch relocated by overriding HOME for the rungms call: rungms hardcodes `set SCR=~/scr` / `set USERSCR=~/scr` as csh `set` statements, which no environment variable can override, but csh expands `~` from HOME. rungms runs under `csh -f`, so it never reads .cshrc and the override has no other effect.
